notes.title: First Day of PostLife...
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! I am happy to announce that PostLife is out as of today!
I've spent most of the day patching out small fixes and taking note of a few small changes that I'd like to make. But there are two major things I'd like to comment on...

Steam Achievements, as of now they are listed for the game. I thought they worked, but they don't activate at all. I thought this would be a quick fix but it is taking much longer than I thought. So more updates on achievements will come later on...

I'd also like to extend an apology to those playing on Steamdeck, I've heard reports from multiple friends that playing Postlife on Steamdeck results in bizarre crashes and bugs that I haven't been able to figure out yet. I will continue to look into these as well, although I cannot guarantee the game will a good experience on Steamdeck as of now. :(

Thank you to everyone who is supporting the game! It means a lot ^^

notes.title: PostLife is almost here!
notes.notes:
[i][b]Hey there everyone! [/b][/i]
After a lot of work, [i]PostLife[/i] will finally be releasing!!! 
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44949585/dfe91f3f1952581d5752319eb069fb229cb74330.png[/img]

Just wanted to give a heads up to those who are keeping an eye on the game. After the launch, PostLife will be [u][b]40% OFF[/b][/u] for the first seven days. I want to extend my thanks to everyone who gives the game a chance and plays it, you have my gratitude! WOOO-YAAAY!!! ^^

[i]A side note about testing / updates...[/i]
Not sure how many bug reports the game will get, but I want to ensure the game is always in a playable state. From what I've tested this seems to be true, but bugs tend to reveal themselves with time. In a few weeks I'll be at college and very busy, so fixes and such might be slower than I'd like. If PostLife faces any game-breaking bugs I will do my best to release updates as quickly as I can, but that might be a bit slow for some.

Thank you for reading and I hope you can give PostLife a try! :)

notes.title: 100 Wishlists on Postlife!
notes.notes:
Hello everybody! 

I just wanted to[i] thank you all[/i] for [b]100 wishlists[/b]! The game isn't even out yet and seeing so many silly lil numbers go up makes me so happy!!! ːcharmedː

To anyone reading who as supported my game in even the slightest way, or simply enjoyed what I've made; thank you so much. The ability to have my work seen by anyone is an honor in it's own right. 

[b]Now[/b], I can't just post without any proper news...
So quickly I will outline the state of Postlife and any post-release plans I have for it.

Firstly, the game is [i]very[/i] close to complete! The last major addition I need to complete is adding all the music into the game. At this point I am waiting on my very talented musician to finish up their work so I can implement it. I suspect the rest of the game's music will be done within the next [i]1-2 months[/i] :)

As for playtesting and bug fixes, I have done my best to hand the game to many friends. I'm at a point where even playing through large sections of the game doesn't yield any major issues. ([i]Maybe a spelling error or two.[/i]) I'm certain I'll still need to fix bugs post-release, but that is inevitable.

Finally, once the game is out I'm gonna do my best to get the game's soundtrack on [i]Spotify[/i].
Honestly it's mostly for my own sake, haha! Either way, that's mostly it for updates, thank you all so much. :)
